definition_zh: 翻译；译成；转化；解释；被译成
definition_en: to express words in another language, or to change something into a different form or result
core_image: 一句话从一个人嘴里出来，落到另一个人嘴里时换了一副字
scene: 餐桌上，一位老奶奶只会方言，孙女把她的吩咐一句句换成普通话讲给客人听。She translated her grandmother’s story for the guests.
sceneCN: 这里 translate 是「把话译成另一种语言」（第 1 个义项：口头或书面翻译）；句意为她把奶奶讲的故事译给客人听。话从一张嘴搬到另一张嘴的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ion 构成名词，义为「翻译；译文」
动词加 -or 构成，义为「译者；翻译员」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可译的」

senses.title: To express in another language
senses.definition: to say or write words again in a different language
senses.definitionCN: 用另一种语言把话语或文字重新表达
senses.example: She translates poetry from Japanese into English.
senses.exampleCN: 她把日本诗歌译成英文。
senses.why: The Latin latus means carried, so to translate is to carry a meaning across into another tongue.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 latus 意为「被搬运」，所以 translate 就是把意义搬到另一种语言里。

senses.title: To turn into another form or result
senses.definition: to change something into a different form or practical result
senses.definitionCN: 把某物变成另一种形式或实际结果
senses.example: Good plans rarely translate into good results easily.
senses.exampleCN: 好计划很少能轻易变成好结果。
senses.why: Once meaning can be carried across, any conversion from one state to another fits the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义能被搬过去，那么任何从一种状态到另一种的转换都能用这个动词。

senses.title: To explain or understand in one’s own terms
senses.definition: to explain or understand something in a way one can grasp
senses.definitionCN: 用自己能把握的方式解释或理解某物
senses.example: He translated her silence as agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 他把她的沉默理解为同意。
senses.why: Readers carry a text into their own frame, and that carrying is also a translation.
senses.whyCN: 读者把文本搬进自己的框架，这一次搬运同样是翻译。

senses.title: To be capable of being translated
senses.definition: to be able to be put into another language with its meaning kept
senses.definitionCN: 能被译成另一种语言而意义不失
senses.example: This joke does not translate well.
senses.exampleCN: 这个笑话一译就走味。
senses.why: When the load cannot be carried without damage, we say the thing does not translate.
senses.whyCN: 当那担货搬过去必然受损时，我们就说这个东西译不好。

senses.title: To move a bishop to another see
senses.definition: to move a bishop from one diocese to another
senses.definitionCN: 把主教从一个教区调到另一个
senses.example: He was translated to a northern diocese.
senses.exampleCN: 他被调任到北方一个教区。
senses.why: This is the oldest English sense: a holy man is carried to a new seat.
senses.whyCN: 这是英语里最古老的义项：把神职人员搬到新的座位。

intro.en: The verb comes from Latin translatus, the past participle of transferre, to carry across.
intro.cn: 这个动词来自拉丁语 translatus，是 transferre（搬运过去）的过去分词。

items.en: Ferre means to carry, and its participle latus means carried, born, or brought.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为搬运，其分词 latus 意为被搬、被承载。

items.en: Translatus is a carrying across, used of moving goods, of people, and later of meaning.
items.cn: translatus 是一次搬运过去，先用于货物与人，后用于意义。

items.en: Old French translater gives English the verb with the sense of turning text into another tongue.
items.cn: 古法语 translater 把这个动词传入英语，含「把文本换成另一种语言」之义。

items.en: English uses it from the fourteenth century for rendering texts, and later for other conversions.
items.cn: 英语从十四世纪用它指译文本，后来又扩及其他转换。

items.en: Biology and business extend it to protein synthesis and to results.
items.cn: 生物学与商业又把它扩展到蛋白质合成与成效。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -lat- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs about rendering and explaining.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -lat- 词干，近义组汇集表示转换与解释的其他动词。

normalIntro.en: The -lat- inside the word is the Latin participle carried, and it ties the whole family together.
normalIntro.cn: 词中的 -lat- 就是拉丁语分词「被搬运」，把整个词族连在一起。

normal.en: Trans- is across and latus is carried, so translate is to carry meaning across.
normal.cn: trans- 是跨过，latus 是被搬运，所以 translate 就是把意义搬过去。

normal.en: Translation is the act or the text, translator is the person.
normal.cn: translation 是行为或文本，translator 是人。

normal.en: Transfer and relate are cousins, built on the same carried root.
normal.cn: transfer 与 relate 是表亲，建在同一个「搬运」词根上。

normal.en: Ideas can be translated into action, which is the figurative use.
normal.cn: 想法可以 translate into action，这是比喻用法。

normal.en: A joke that does not translate loses its point on the way across.
normal.cn: 译不通的笑话在搬运途中丢了意思。

abstract.en: Picture one sentence stepping off a boat on the other shore.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话在彼岸下船。

abstract.en: Hear it land in another alphabet, the meaning still whole.
abstract.cn: 听它落在另一套字母里，意思仍然完整。

abstract.en: Then picture the same sentence as a plan, landing as a deed.
abstract.cn: 再把这同一句话想成计划，落地时成了行动。

examples.en: He translates French novels for a living.
examples.cn: 他靠翻译法国小说为生。

examples.en: Their enthusiasm did not translate into votes.
examples.cn: 他们的热情并没有变成选票。

examples.en: I translated his silence as a refusal.
examples.cn: 我把他的沉默理解为拒绝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯雷特」——把话穿过一条街，送到雷特先生的耳朵里。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ latus（ferre「搬运」的过去分词），动词 transferre 经古法语 translater 进入英语；同族有 transfer、relate

sensesIntro.en: The senses all describe carrying something across a gap: a language, a state, or a silence.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都描述把某物跨过一道距离搬过去：跨语言、跨状态，或跨过一段沉默。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sentence leaving one mouth and landing in another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句话从一张嘴出来，落进另一张嘴。

branches.en: The language pair: rendering a text, and failing to render it well.
branches.cn: 语言一对：把文本译出，或译不好。

branches.en: The conversion sense, where a plan becomes a result.
branches.cn: 转化义：计划变成结果。

branches.en: The reading sense, where a silence is carried into meaning.
branches.cn: 阅读义：沉默被搬成意义。

branches.en: The church sense, where a bishop is carried to a new seat.
branches.cn: 教会义：主教被搬到新的座位。

branches.en: The plain translating sense, where words are the load.
branches.cn: 朴素翻译义：那担货是词语。

intro.cn: 这个动词是表示跨越的拉丁前缀加上「搬运」动词的分词。

latinIntro.en: Ferre and its participle latus lie behind a very large English family.
latinIntro.cn: ferre 及其分词 latus 支撑着一个非常庞大的英语词族。

definition_zh: 翻译；译文；转化；译作
definition_en: the act of turning words into another language, or the text produced that way
core_image: 一叠稿纸被搬到对岸，落地时已经换成另一种文字
scene: 出版社的编辑桌上有两叠稿纸，左边是原文，右边是译者交来的另一国文字。The translation of the novel took her almost two years.
sceneCN: 这里 translation 是「翻译（这件事）」（第 1 个义项：把文字换成另一种语言）；句意为这部小说的翻译花了她将近两年。桌上一左一右的两叠稿纸正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀 -ion 还原为动词，义为「翻译」
由动词加 -or 构成，义为「译者」
名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「翻译的；转化研究的」

senses.title: The act of rendering into another language
senses.definition: the work or process of expressing text in another language
senses.definitionCN: 把文本用另一种语言表达出来的工作或过程
senses.example: Translation demands patience as much as talent.
senses.exampleCN: 翻译既要有天分，也要有耐心。
senses.why: Latus means carried, so translation names the carrying of meaning from one tongue to another.
senses.whyCN: latus 意为「被搬运」，所以 translation 指的就是把意义从一种语言扛到另一种语言。

senses.title: A text in another language
senses.definition: the written result of translating, a text in the target language
senses.definitionCN: 翻译之后写出来的成品，即目标语言的文本
senses.example: I read the Chinese translation of the play.
senses.exampleCN: 我读了这个剧本的中文译本。
senses.why: Once the act is done, the load itself takes the name, and the finished text is called a translation.
senses.whyCN: 动作做完之后，那担货本身也得了这个名字，成品文本就叫译文。

senses.title: A change into another form or state
senses.definition: the process of changing something into a different form or result
senses.definitionCN: 某物变成另一种形式或结果的过程
senses.example: The translation of theory into practice is slow.
senses.exampleCN: 理论向实践的转化是缓慢的。
senses.why: Because the root only means carried across, any movement from one state to another can be called a translation.
senses.whyCN: 因为词根本身只表示「搬过去」，任何从一种状态到另一种的移动都可称为转化。

senses.title: Movement from one place to another
senses.definition: the removal of a person or thing to another place, especially a bishop to another see
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物移到另一处，尤指主教调任
senses.example: His translation to the northern diocese surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他调任北方教区让所有人都很意外。
senses.why: This is the earliest English sense, since the word first named the moving of a holy man to a new seat.
senses.whyCN: 这是英语中最早的义项，因为这个词最初指把神职人员搬到新的座位。

senses.title: Motion with no rotation
senses.definition: movement in which every point of a body shifts the same distance in the same direction
senses.definitionCN: 物体上每个点都以相同距离向同一方向移动
senses.example: In pure translation, every point of the box moves alike.
senses.exampleCN: 在纯平动中，箱子的每个点移动得一模一样。
senses.why: Physics keeps the plain sense of carrying over: the whole body is carried to a new place without turning.
senses.whyCN: 物理保留了最朴素的「搬过去」义：整个物体被搬到新位置而不转动。

intro.en: The noun comes from Latin translatio, a carrying across, formed on latus, carried, and the prefix trans-, across.
intro.cn: 这个名词来自拉丁语 translatio，意为「搬运过去」，由 latus（被搬运）与前缀 trans-（穿过）构成。

items.en: Latus is the past participle of ferre, to carry, and names the thing that has been carried.
items.cn: latus 是 ferre（搬运）的过去分词，指被搬过的那个东西。

items.en: Translatio means a transferring, first of goods or of a bishop, and later of meaning.
items.cn: 拉丁语 translatio 意为转移，先指货物或主教，后指意义。

items.en: Old French translation keeps the sense of a transfer or removal.
items.cn: 古法语 translation 保留了转移、迁走的含义。

items.en: English uses the word for a bishop’s removal from the thirteenth century, and for rendering text from the sixteenth.
items.cn: 英语从十三世纪用它指主教调任，十六世纪起用它指翻译文本。

items.en: Modern science adds the mechanical sense of motion without rotation.
items.cn: 现代科学又添上「不旋转的移动」这一力学义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -lat- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers words about the text and the work of rendering.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -lat- 词干，近义组汇集与译稿和转写工作相关的词。

normalIntro.en: Once you see latus, carried, the whole family becomes easy to place.
normalIntro.cn: 看到 latus（被搬运）之后，整个词族就好定位了。

normal.en: Translate is the verb, translation the noun, and translator the person.
normal.cn: translate 是动词，translation 是名词，translator 是人。

normal.en: The -tion ending marks a finished act or its product, so the noun can mean both the work and the text.
normal.cn: -tion 结尾标记已完成的行为或其产物，所以名词既可指工作也可指成品。

normal.en: Compare relation and transfer, which build on the same carried root.
normal.cn: 对比 relation 与 transfer，它们建在同一个「搬运」词根上。

normal.en: In a library, the shelf label usually means the finished book, not the labour.
normal.cn: 在图书馆里，这个标签通常指成品书，而不是那份劳动。

normal.en: The physics sense drops all language and keeps only the carrying.
normal.cn: 物理义抛开语言，只留下搬运这一层。

abstract.en: Picture two stacks of paper on one desk, one in each script.
abstract.cn: 想象同一张桌上两叠纸，各用一种文字。

abstract.en: Hear the soft rustle as one stack is laid down as the other.
abstract.cn: 听见一叠放下、另一叠成形的轻响。

abstract.en: Think of the bridge as invisible, and only the landing visible.
abstract.cn: 把桥想成看不见的，能看见的只有着陆。

examples.en: His translation of the poem keeps the rhyme of the original.
examples.cn: 他的译文保留了原诗的韵脚。

examples.en: The translation from idea to product took five years.
examples.cn: 从想法到产品的转化花了五年。

examples.en: She checked two translations before choosing one.
examples.cn: 她比较了两个译本之后才选定一个。

sensesIntro.en: The senses divide neatly between the act, the product, and the movement, because all three can be called a carrying across.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项在「行为」「成品」「移动」三处分开，因为这三样都能叫一次搬运。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of pages set down on the far bank in new letters.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠稿纸在对岸落地，字已经换了。

branches.en: The labour sense, where the carrying is the work itself.
branches.cn: 劳动义：搬运本身就是那份工作。

branches.en: The product sense, where the carried load takes the name.
branches.cn: 成品义：被搬的货承接了名字。

branches.en: The state-change sense, where meaning is carried into practice or effect.
branches.cn: 状态义：意义被搬进实践或效果。

branches.en: The older sense of moving a person to a new seat.
branches.cn: 较老的义项：把人搬到新的座位。

branches.en: The mechanical sense, where a whole body is carried without turning.
branches.cn: 力学义：整个物体被搬动而不旋转。

intro.cn: 这个名词由拉丁前缀、分词与名词词尾三层组成，每一层都能在其他词里看到。

definition_zh: 运输；交通；运输工具；运送；流放
definition_en: the movement of people or goods from one place to another, or the vehicles used for it
core_image: 一排货车排成长队，把成箱的货物从一座城搬到另一座城
scene: 公路上货车一辆接一辆，满载箱子朝港口开去。Public transport is the cheapest way to reach the harbor.
sceneCN: 这里 transport 是「交通、运输工具」（第 2 个义项：运送人或货的交通工具）；句意为公共交通是去港口最便宜的方式。货车长队正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ation 构成名词，义为「运输；运输系统」
动词加 -er 构成，义为「运输者；运输车辆」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可运输的」

senses.title: The moving of goods or people
senses.definition: the act of carrying people or goods from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把人或货物从一处运到另一处
senses.example: The transport of grain by rail is cheap.
senses.exampleCN: 用铁路运粮很便宜。
senses.why: The Latin portare means to carry, so transport is a carrying across a distance.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 portare 意为「搬运」，所以 transport 就是跨距离的搬运。

senses.title: A system or means of travel
senses.definition: the system of vehicles, roads, and routes used for travelling
senses.definitionCN: 用于出行的车辆、道路与路线的整套体系
senses.example: The city has excellent public transport.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市公共交通很好。
senses.why: When the carrying becomes a regular service, the system itself takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 当搬运变成固定的服务，整套系统本身就承接了这个名字。

senses.title: A vehicle for troops or goods
senses.definition: a ship, aircraft, or lorry used to carry soldiers or supplies
senses.definitionCN: 用来运送士兵或物资的船、飞机或卡车
senses.example: The troops crossed in a transport.
senses.exampleCN: 部队乘运输舰过海。
senses.why: A single carrier is just one instance of the carrying activity, so the noun names the craft too.
senses.whyCN: 一件运载工具只是搬运活动的一个实例，于是名词也用来指这种船或车。

senses.title: Strong emotion that carries one away
senses.definition: to carry someone away with joy, anger, or other feeling
senses.definitionCN: 让某人被喜悦或愤怒等情绪带走
senses.example: The music transported her back to childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐把她带回了童年。
senses.why: If the body can be carried across space, the mind can be carried across time and feeling.
senses.whyCN: 身体可以被搬过空间，心也可以被搬过时间与情感。

senses.title: To send someone away as punishment
senses.definition: to send a criminal to a distant place as a punishment
senses.definitionCN: 把罪犯送到远方作为惩罚
senses.example: Convicts were transported to the island.
senses.exampleCN: 囚犯被流放到那个岛上。
senses.why: The earliest English legal sense is being carried across the sea against one’s will.
senses.whyCN: 英语里最早的法律义项，就是被人强制运过大洋。

intro.en: The word is Latin trans-, across, plus portare, to carry, so it literally means carried across.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语 trans-（穿过）加 portare（搬运），字面就是「被搬过去」。

items.en: Portare means to carry or bear, and gives port, porter, and portable.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为搬运、承载，生出 port、porter、portable。

items.en: Transportare means to carry over or across, used of goods and of people.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transportare 意为运过去、搬过去，用于货物也用于人。

items.en: Old French transporter keeps the sense of carrying something over.
items.cn: 古法语 transporter 保留了把东西运过去的含义。

items.en: English uses the verb for moving goods, and from the seventeenth century for banishing convicts.
items.cn: 英语用这个动词指运货，十七世纪起又指流放囚犯。

items.en: Railways and motor traffic turn the noun into the name of a whole system of travel.
items.cn: 铁路与汽车交通使这个名词成为整套出行系统的名称。

note.en: The look-alike group shows other portare words and the trans- prefix, while the near-meaning group gathers words for carrying and shipping.
note.cn: 形近组列出其他 portare 词与 trans- 前缀，近义组汇集表示运送与航运的词。

normalIntro.en: Portare, to carry, is the heart of the word and of a large family.
normalIntro.cn: portare（搬运）是这个词的核心，也是一个大家族的根。

normal.en: Trans- is across, portare is carry, so transport is carry across.
normal.cn: trans- 是跨过，portare 是搬，所以 transport 就是搬过去。

normal.en: Porter is the person who carries, from the same root.
normal.cn: porter 是搬运的人，同出这个词根。

normal.en: Portable is the adjective for what can be carried.
normal.cn: portable 是可被搬走的形容词。

normal.en: Import and export add in and out to the same carrying root.
normal.cn: import 与 export 给同一个「搬」词根加上进与出。

normal.en: Transportation is the longer noun used more in American English.
normal.cn: transportation 是更长的名词，美式英语更常用。

abstract.en: Picture a convoy of lorries nose to tail on a night road.
abstract.cn: 想象夜间公路上首尾相接的车队。

abstract.en: Hear the boxes slide as each lorry takes a bend.
abstract.cn: 听见每个箱子在车转弯时滑动。

abstract.en: Then think of a mind carried away by a song, the same motion inside.
abstract.cn: 再想一颗心被歌声带走，是同一个动作。

examples.en: The company transports fresh fruit to three provinces.
examples.cn: 这家公司把新鲜水果运到三个省。

examples.en: Cheap public transport keeps the city moving.
examples.cn: 便宜的公共交通让城市运转不停。

examples.en: Prisoners were once transported to distant colonies.
examples.cn: 囚犯曾经被流放到遥远的殖民地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯坡特」——东西一路穿过坡地运到特别远的地方。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ portare（搬运），动词 transportare 经古法语进入英语；同族有 porter、portable、import、export

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the plain act of carrying to the emotion that carries a person away.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从朴素的搬运，一路走到把人带走的情绪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: lorries nose to tail carrying crates across the country.
core.cn: 核心意象：首尾相接的货车把箱子运过整个国家。

branches.en: The plain act of carrying goods or people.
branches.cn: 最朴素的义项：搬货或载人。

branches.en: The system and the single vehicle, two ways of naming the carrying.
branches.cn: 体系与单件工具：命名搬运的两种方式。

branches.en: The emotional sense, where the mind is what gets carried.
branches.cn: 情感义：被搬走的是心。

branches.en: The legal sense, where a person is carried away by force.
branches.cn: 法律义：人被强制运走。

branches.en: The plain carrying sense, where crates are the load.
branches.cn: 朴素搬运义：箱子就是那担货。

intro.en: The word joins a Latin prefix of crossing to a Latin verb of carrying.
intro.cn: 这个词把表示跨越的拉丁前缀与拉丁语「搬运」动词连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Portare is behind a large family: port, porter, portable, import, export, and transport.
latinIntro.cn: portare 支撑着一个大家族：port、porter、portable、import、export 与 transport。

items.exampleCN: 跨大西洋电缆越过大洋。

items.example: The stem gives porter and portable.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 porter 与 portable。
他们把茶叶出口到欧洲。

items.example: A portable radio fits in a bag.
items.exampleCN: 便携收音机能放进口袋。
搬运工拿走了我们的行李。

definition_zh: 运输；运送；运输系统；交通工具；流放
definition_en: the act of moving people or goods, or the system of vehicles and routes that does it
core_image: 一张城市地图上，线密密麻麻地把码头、车站与仓库连成一张网
scene: 规划师摊开一张大地图，上面铁路、公路、航线交织成网，把港口与内陆的仓库都连了起来。The city spends heavily on transportation every year.
sceneCN: 这里 transportation 是「运输系统」（第 3 个义项：车辆与线路构成的体系）；句意为这座城市每年在交通上投入巨大。地图上的那张网就是本词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀 -ation 还原为动词，义为「运输」
名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「运输的」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「运输者；运输车」

senses.title: The act of carrying things
senses.definition: the act or business of moving goods or people from place to place
senses.definitionCN: 把货物或人从一个地方运到另一个地方的行为或行业
senses.example: The transportation of coal by river is slow but cheap.
senses.exampleCN: 用河道运煤慢但便宜。
senses.why: Portare means to carry, so transportation names the carrying across places.
senses.whyCN: portare 意为搬运，所以 transportation 指跨地区的那一搬运。

senses.title: The vehicles that carry people
senses.definition: the vehicles, such as buses and trains, that carry people
senses.definitionCN: 公交车、火车这类载人的车辆
senses.example: She has no transportation of her own.
senses.exampleCN: 她没有自己的交通工具。
senses.why: The word can name the carriers themselves rather than the act, because they are what does the carrying.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也可以指承载者本身而非动作，因为干搬运活的就是它们。

senses.title: The whole system of moving
senses.definition: the organised system of roads, rails, and routes
senses.definitionCN: 由道路、铁路与航线组织起来的体系
senses.example: The city invests in green transportation.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市投资绿色交通。
senses.why: Once routes and vehicles are planned together, the whole network takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 当线路与车辆被一起规划，整张网络就承接了这个名字。

senses.title: Being moved from one place to another
senses.definition: the state of being carried somewhere, often to another country
senses.definitionCN: 被运到某处的状态，常指被运往他国
senses.example: The records were lost during their transportation.
senses.exampleCN: 这些档案在运送途中丢了。
senses.why: The passive side of carrying is also covered: it is what happens to the thing carried.
senses.whyCN: 搬运的被动一面也被涵盖：它是被搬之物所经历的事。

senses.title: Punishment by exile
senses.definition: the punishment of sending a criminal to a distant place
senses.definitionCN: 把罪犯送到远方的刑罚
senses.example: Transportation to the colonies ended in the nineteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 向殖民地流放的刑罚在十九世纪终止。
senses.why: The harshest use of being carried away by force became a fixed name for a sentence.
senses.whyCN: 「被强制运走」最严厉的用法，固定成了刑罚的名称。

intro.en: The noun is transport plus -ation, built on Latin portare, to carry, and trans-, across.
intro.cn: 这个名词是 transport 加 -ation，建在拉丁语 portare（搬运）与 trans-（穿过）之上。

items.en: Portare means to carry, and supplies the -port- in transport, import, and export.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为搬运，提供 transport、import、export 中的 -port-。

items.en: Transportare means to carry over, and the noun transportatio names the carrying.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transportare 意为运过去，名词 transportatio 指这一搬运。

items.en: French transportation and the verb transporter pass the sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 transportation 与动词 transporter 把这一含义传入英语。

items.en: English uses the noun for the carrying of goods, and for penal exile abroad.
items.cn: 英语用这个名词指运货，也指流放海外。

items.en: In American English the long noun is the everyday word for the travel system.
items.cn: 在美式英语里，这个较长的名词就是日常说的「交通系统」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the portare stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for moving goods.
note.cn: 形近组共用 portare 词干，近义组汇集搬运货物的其他说法。

normalIntro.en: This is simply transport plus -ation, and both halves help.
normalIntro.cn: 这不过是 transport 加 -ation，两半都有用。

normal.en: Portare means carry, so the noun is about carrying things around.
normal.cn: portare 意为搬，所以这个名词与搬东西有关。

normal.en: The -ation ending marks a process or system, not a single act.
normal.cn: -ation 词尾标记过程或系统，而不是单次动作。

normal.en: American signs say public transportation where British ones say public transport.
normal.cn: 美国标牌写 public transportation，英国写 public transport。

normal.en: Export and import share the root and describe direction.
normal.cn: export 与 import 共用词根，描述方向。

normal.en: The penal sense survives in history books about the colonies.
normal.cn: 流放义还活在讲殖民地的历史书里。

abstract.en: Picture a map where every dot is joined by a coloured line.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，每个点都被彩色线连起来。

abstract.en: Feel the whole net hum with goods moving at night.
abstract.cn: 感受整张网在夜里嗡嗡运转。

abstract.en: Then see a single ship taking one person away for ever.
abstract.cn: 再看见一条船把一个人永远带走。

examples.en: Transportation costs add a third to the price.
examples.cn: 运输成本让价格多出三成。

examples.en: Many students rely on public transportation.
examples.cn: 许多学生依赖公共交通。

examples.en: The museum explains the history of penal transportation.
examples.cn: 博物馆讲解流放刑罚的历史。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯坡特申」——穿过坡地一路运送，申成一张交通网。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ portare（搬运）+ 名词后缀 -ation；由动词 transportare 经法语进入英语，同族有 transport、import、export

sensesIntro.en: The senses split between the act, the vehicles, the network, and the harshest form of being carried off.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项分开在动作、车辆、网络，以及「被强制运走」这一最严厉形态上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a city map woven from rail, road, and shipping lines.
core.cn: 核心意象：由铁路、公路与航线织成的城市地图。

branches.en: The act and its passive side: things are carried, or are being carried.
branches.cn: 动作与其被动面：搬东西，或正被搬。

branches.en: The vehicle sense, where the carriers themselves are meant.
branches.cn: 车辆义：指的是承载者本身。

branches.en: The network sense, the everyday American use of the word.
branches.cn: 网络义：美式英语里最常见的用法。

branches.en: The penal sense, where carrying becomes punishment.
branches.cn: 刑罚义：搬运变成了惩罚。

branches.en: The business sense, where a river carries coal.
branches.cn: 行业义：河道在运煤。

intro.en: The noun adds a Latin noun ending to a verb that already means to carry across.
intro.cn: 这个名词给「运过去」的动词加上拉丁名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Portare and its compounds fill the language of trade and travel.
latinIntro.cn: portare 及其复合词塞满了贸易与旅行的词汇。

definition_zh: 陷阱；圈套；捕捉；困住；使陷入困境
definition_en: a device or plan for catching something, or to catch and hold something so it cannot escape
core_image: 草丛里一块铺了落叶的木板，脚一踩便弹起铁夹
scene: 林子里，猎人在兽径上安了一块带机关的木板，上面盖了层落叶。A rabbit was caught in the trap before dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 trap 是「陷阱」（第 1 个义项：捕捉用的装置）；句意为天亮前一只兔子落进了陷阱。盖着落叶的木板与铁夹正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -er 构成，义为「设陷阱捕兽的人」
现在分词名词化，义为「捕捉；捕兽业」；复数指马饰
加前缀 en- 构成，义为「诱捕；使陷入」

senses.title: A device for catching animals
senses.definition: a device, often hidden, that catches and holds an animal
senses.definitionCN: 常被藏起来的装置，用来抓住并留住动物
senses.example: The farmer set traps for the rats.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫设了捕鼠夹。
senses.why: The word is an old English name for a snare, and its whole sense is a hidden catch that closes.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是古英语里对罗网的称呼，全部含义就是一道藏起来的、会合上的机关。

senses.title: A plan that deceives someone
senses.definition: a trick or plan that makes someone do what you want
senses.definitionCN: 诱使别人按你的意图行动的计谋
senses.example: The offer was a trap to get his signature.
senses.exampleCN: 那个提议是个骗他签字的圈套。
senses.why: A snare for an animal and a snare for a person share the same shape: a hidden catch.
senses.whyCN: 给动物设的套与给人的套形状相同：都是藏起来的机关。

senses.title: A bad situation one cannot leave
senses.definition: a difficult situation that is hard to escape from
senses.definitionCN: 难以脱身的艰难处境
senses.example: Debt can become a trap for young families.
senses.exampleCN: 债务可能成为年轻家庭的困境。
senses.why: When the catch is circumstances rather than jaws, the word still pictures something closing around a person.
senses.whyCN: 当合上的不是铁夹而是处境，这个词画的仍是有什么在人周围合拢。

senses.title: To catch and hold an animal
senses.definition: to catch an animal in a trap or by a similar means
senses.definitionCN: 用陷阱或类似办法抓住动物
senses.example: They trapped rabbits in the orchard.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在果园里捕兔。
senses.why: The verb is the action the noun describes: to close the catch on something.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是名词描述的那个动作：把机关合在某个东西上。

senses.title: To prevent from escaping
senses.definition: to hold people or things somewhere so they cannot move or leave
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物留在某处，使其动不了或走不了
senses.example: Rescuers freed the miners trapped underground.
senses.exampleCN: 救援人员救出了困在地下的矿工。
senses.why: Prisons and collapses both close a space around a person, which is the trap image without the jaws.
senses.whyCN: 监牢与塌方都在人身周围合拢一块空间，这正是去掉铁夹的陷阱画面。

senses.title: To hold heat or gas in place
senses.definition: to keep heat, gas, or light from escaping
senses.definitionCN: 不让热、气或光跑掉
senses.example: Thick walls trap warmth in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 厚墙在冬天能留住热量。
senses.why: A layer that does not let something out acts like a trap that does not let something in.
senses.whyCN: 一层不让东西出去的材料，就像一道不让东西进来的陷阱。

intro.en: The noun is an old English word for a snare, and the verb grows from it in the same period.
intro.cn: 这是古英语里表示罗网的名词，动词也在同一时期由它生出。

items.en: Treppe means a snare or trap, and is used of devices for catching wild animals.
items.cn: 古英语 treppe 意为罗网、陷阱，指捕捉野兽的装置。

items.en: The word has relatives in Dutch and Low German, all naming a catching device.
items.cn: 这个词在荷兰语与低地德语里都有亲族，都指捕捉装置。

items.en: The noun widens from animal snares to tricks that catch people.
items.cn: 中世纪英语里，这个名词从兽夹扩展到能套住人的计谋。

items.en: Railways and mining give the verb its sense of being shut in and unable to escape.
items.cn: 铁路与采矿给了动词「被困住、逃不掉」的义项。

items.en: Modern technology adds the sense of holding heat, gas, or light where it is wanted.
items.cn: 现代技术又添上「把热、气或光留在该留之处」的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that differ by one letter, while the near-meaning group names other snares and holds.
note.cn: 形近组汇集只差一个字母的短词，近义组列出其他圈套与困住的说法。

normalIntro.en: Four letters, but the image does all the work.
normalIntro.cn: 只有四个字母，但画面就能记住。

normal.en: Think of a trap door: the same short word sits in front.
normal.cn: 想想 trap door（活板门）：同一个短词就在前面。

normal.en: The verb doubles the p in the past: trapped.
normal.cn: 过去式双写 p：trapped。

normal.en: A trapper is the person, trapping is the work.
normal.cn: trapper 是人，trapping 是那份活。

normal.en: Entrap adds en- to make a verb of catching someone in a trick.
normal.cn: entrap 加 en-，成为「设计套人」的动词。

normal.en: A speed trap catches cars, not rabbits, with the same logic.
normal.cn: 测速陷阱抓的是车不是兔，逻辑却一样。

abstract.en: Picture leaves over a board, and the board springs up.
abstract.cn: 想象落叶盖着木板，木板一下弹起。

abstract.en: Hear the click before you see the jaws.
abstract.cn: 先听见那咔哒声，再看见铁夹。

abstract.en: Feel a space close around you, walls instead of jaws.
abstract.cn: 再感受空间在你周围合上，墙代替了铁夹。

examples.en: The mouse escaped the trap twice.
examples.cn: 那只老鼠两次逃出了捕鼠夹。

examples.en: They were trapped in the elevator for an hour.
examples.cn: 他们被困在电梯里一个小时。

examples.en: The glass traps heat from the winter sun.
examples.cn: 这种玻璃能留住冬日阳光的热量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「揣谱」——揣着谱子在林子里设套，一下就套住了。

root: 古英语 treppe（罗网、捕兽器），与荷兰语、低地德语同源；同族有 trapper、trapping、entrap

sensesIntro.en: The word always pictures something closing around a thing so that it cannot get out.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词总是画着「有什么在某物周围合上，让它出不来」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a board hidden under leaves, snapping shut.
core.cn: 核心意象：盖在落叶下的木板，一下合上。

branches.en: The physical pair: the device and the act of catching with it.
branches.cn: 实物一对：装置，以及用装置去抓的动作。

branches.en: The trick sense, where the snare is a plan aimed at a person.
branches.cn: 诡计义：罗网是针对人设的计划。

branches.en: The confinement senses, where circumstances take the place of jaws.
branches.cn: 困住义：处境取代了铁夹。

branches.en: The physical containment sense, where heat is what cannot get out.
branches.cn: 物理封存义：出不去的是热。

branches.en: The catching sense, where a hunter closes the jaws on a rabbit.
branches.cn: 捕捉义：猎人在兔子身上合上铁夹。

intro.en: This is a native word, so the pieces are suffixes rather than Latin roots.
intro.cn: 这是本族词，所以拆出来的是后缀而非拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: The stem trapp- appears in trapper, trapping, and the verb entrap.
latinIntro.cn: 词干 trapp- 出现在 trapper、trapping 与动词 entrap 里。

items.example: The stem is the whole of trap.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干就是 trap 的全部。
en- 加 trap 成为 entrap。

items.example: They tried to entrap the witness.
items.exampleCN: 他们试图诱使证人落套。

items.example: The climbers were trapped by snow.
Trapping was once common in the north.
items.exampleCN: 捕兽业曾在北方很常见。

items.meaning: loops of wire for catching birds
items.example: Old snares were loops, not jaws.
items.exampleCN: old snares 指套索，不是铁夹。

definition_zh: 垃圾；废物；蹩脚货；丢弃；捣毁
definition_en: things thrown away because they are no longer wanted, or to throw such things away or destroy them
core_image: 楼道口一只鼓鼓的垃圾袋，袋口露出几根果皮
scene: 清晨，环卫车沿街收走门口一袋袋垃圾，纸箱被压扁堆在路边。Please take the trash out before you leave.
sceneCN: 这里 trash 是「垃圾」（第 1 个义项：扔掉的废弃物）；句意为走之前把垃圾拿出去。门口那一袋袋东西正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 名词加 -y 构成形容词，义为「劣质的；低俗的」
复合名词，义为「垃圾桶」（美式）
现在分词名词化，义为「捣毁；痛批」

senses.title: Things thrown away
senses.definition: things that are no longer wanted and are thrown out
senses.definitionCN: 不再需要、被扔掉的东西
senses.example: The kitchen trash smells in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天厨房的垃圾会有味道。
senses.why: The word began as a name for broken twigs and dry leaves, the stuff that falls and is swept up.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早指折断的细枝与枯叶，即落下后被扫走的东西。

senses.title: Something of poor quality
senses.definition: things or work that are worthless or of very low quality
senses.definitionCN: 没有价值或质量极差的东西或作品
senses.example: The film is pure trash.
senses.exampleCN: 这部片子完全是垃圾。
senses.why: If what is thrown away is worthless, anything worthless can be called trash.
senses.whyCN: 既然扔掉的东西没有价值，任何没价值的东西都能叫 trash。

senses.title: To throw something away
senses.definition: to get rid of something as useless
senses.definitionCN: 把某物当作无用之物处理掉
senses.example: Trash the old receipts once they are checked.
senses.exampleCN: 旧收据核对完就扔掉。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb when the action of discarding is what needs naming.
senses.whyCN: 当需要给「抛弃」这个动作起名时，名词就变成了动词。

senses.title: To damage or destroy badly
senses.definition: to wreck a place or attack something severely
senses.definitionCN: 把地方砸坏，或把某物批得体无完肤
senses.example: Fans trashed the hall after the show.
senses.exampleCN: 演出结束后粉丝把礼堂砸了。
senses.why: Treating something as trash is the same as destroying it, so the verb widens to wrecking.
senses.whyCN: 把东西当垃圾处理就等于毁掉它，于是动词扩展到「砸烂」。

senses.title: To criticise harshly
senses.definition: to write or speak about something very unfavourably
senses.definitionCN: 极不客气地评论某物
senses.example: Every critic trashed the new play.
senses.exampleCN: 每个评论家都痛批这出新戏。
senses.why: When a review throws a work away in words, the verb for discarding fits the judging.
senses.whyCN: 当评论用文字把作品扔掉时，表示丢弃的这个动词正好贴合那种评判。

intro.en: The word is of uncertain origin, first naming broken twigs and dry leaves, then any rubbish.
intro.cn: 这个词来源不确定，最早指折断的细枝与枯叶，后来泛指一切废物。

items.en: The word appears in the sixteenth century as a name for withered leaves and twigs.
items.cn: 这个词在十六世纪出现，指枯叶与细枝。

items.en: American usage of the nineteenth century widens trash to household rubbish.
items.cn: 十九世纪美国用法把 trash 扩大到家庭垃圾。

items.en: Rubbish, garbage, and trash divide the work differently in British and American English.
items.cn: rubbish、garbage 与 trash 在英式与美式英语里分工不同。

items.en: The verb sense of destroying a place spreads through journalism in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 动词「砸坏一个地方」的义项在二十世纪经新闻传播开来。

items.en: The word now also covers poor quality in films, music, and writing.
items.cn: 如今这个词也涵盖电影、音乐与写作的低劣之作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that look close, while the near-meaning group names other kinds of waste.
note.cn: 形近组汇集外形接近的短词，近义组列出其他废弃物的说法。

normalIntro.en: A short, blunt word, suited to the thing it names.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词又短又硬，正配它所指的东西。

normal.en: Three letters and one sh sound, harsh like a bin lid.
normal.cn: 三个字母，一声 sh，脆得像垃圾桶盖合上。

normal.en: Trash can is American; British speakers more often say rubbish bin.
normal.cn: trash can 是美式，英式多说 rubbish bin。

normal.en: The verb trashes a room, and the noun names what is left.
normal.cn: 动词把房间砸烂，名词指的是留下的一地。

normal.en: Trashy adds -y to make an adjective of poor quality.
normal.cn: trashy 加 -y 成为「劣质」的形容词。

normal.en: A short, blunt word, suited to a quick shove.
normal.cn: 短而硬的词，正配随手一推的动作。

abstract.en: Picture a bin bag split at the corner of a stairwell.
abstract.cn: 想象楼道口一只裂了口的垃圾袋。

abstract.en: Smell it on a hot morning and the word sticks.
abstract.cn: 在热天早晨闻一闻，这个词就记住了。

abstract.en: Then hear a critic say the same word about a play.
abstract.cn: 再听评论家用同一个词评一出戏。

examples.en: Put the trash out on Tuesday night.
examples.cn: 周二晚上把垃圾拿出去。

examples.en: Do not trash the hotel room.
examples.cn: 不要把酒店房间弄得一团糟。

examples.en: Some of that music is real trash.
examples.cn: 那些音乐里有不少真是糟粕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抓什」——抓到什么都往垃圾堆里扔。

root: 来源不确定，十六世纪指枯枝落叶，后泛指垃圾；同族有 trashy、trashcan

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with what is swept up and ends with what is thrown away in words.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从被扫起来的东西开始，一路走到被文字判掉的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bulging bin bag at the foot of the stairs.
core.cn: 核心意象：楼梯脚下一只鼓鼓的垃圾袋。

branches.en: The plain sense of household waste.
branches.cn: 最朴素义：家庭垃圾。

branches.en: The quality sense, where worthless things are meant.
branches.cn: 品质义：指的是没价值的东西。

branches.en: The verb senses: throw away, then wreck.
branches.cn: 动词义：先扔掉，再砸烂。

branches.en: The reviewing sense, where a work is thrown away in print.
branches.cn: 评论义：作品在纸上被扔掉。

branches.en: The bin sense, the everyday picture of the word.
branches.cn: 垃圾桶义：这个词最日常的画面。

intro.en: The word has no useful Latin pieces, but its English family is easy to see.
intro.cn: 这个词没有可用的拉丁部件，但它的英语词族很容易看出。

latinIntro.en: The stem trash- appears in trashy, trashcan, and trashing.
latinIntro.cn: 词干 trash- 出现在 trashy、trashcan 与 trashing 里。

items.example: The stem is the whole noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干就是名词的全部。
trash 加 can 成为 trashcan。

items.example: The trashing of the site caused anger.
items.exampleCN: 对场地的捣毁引发了愤怒。

items.example: Garbage goes in the other bin.

latinEntries.meaning: withered leaves and twigs, then rubbish

definition_zh: 旅行者；旅客；游客；（吉卜赛）流浪者
definition_en: a person who is making a journey or who travels often
core_image: 一个人背着旧背包站在车站大钟下，手里攥着一张长途车票
scene: 长途车站的长椅上，一个背包客把车票与地图摊在膝上等夜车。A tired traveller asked the way to the platform.
sceneCN: 这里 traveller 是「旅行者」（第 1 个义项：正在出行的人）；句意为一个疲惫的旅客问去站台怎么走。车站大钟下背旧包的人正是这个词的画面。

pos.zh: 名词：流浪民族成员（英式）

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 -er 还原为动词，义为「旅行」
美式拼写，少一个 l，义同「旅行者」
由 travel 加 -ogue 构成，义为「旅行见闻录」

senses.title: A person on a journey
senses.definition: someone who is making a trip from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 正在从一处前往另一处的人
senses.example: The traveller arrived after midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 这位旅客午夜后才到。
senses.why: Travel came from an old word for labour, so a traveller is one who takes the trouble of a journey.
senses.whyCN: travel 来自表示「辛劳」的旧词，所以 traveller 就是经历过这趟辛苦的人。

senses.title: A person who travels often
senses.definition: someone who journeys frequently, for work or pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 因工作或游玩经常出行的人
senses.example: She is a seasoned traveller.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个走惯了路的人。
senses.why: Habit turns the name from a single trip into a description of a person.
senses.whyCN: 习惯使这个称呼从一趟行程变成对一个人的描述。

senses.title: A member of a travelling community
senses.definition: a member of a group, such as Irish Travellers, that moves about
senses.definitionCN: 如爱尔兰旅行者这类居无定所的群体成员
senses.example: The site is used by travellers in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 这块场地夏天供流浪民族使用。
senses.why: The name takes a capital letter when it names a whole community rather than a single journey.
senses.whyCN: 当它命名一整个群体而非单次行程时，首字母要大写。

senses.title: A device that moves along something
senses.definition: a part, like a ring or pulley, that runs along a rail or rope
senses.definitionCN: 沿轨道或绳索移动的环、滑轮等部件
senses.example: A traveller runs along the overhead beam.
senses.exampleCN: 一个行件沿横梁滑动。
senses.why: The word for a person on the move is borrowed for a part that moves along a fixed line.
senses.whyCN: 用来指人的「在移动者」被借去指沿固定线路移动的零件。

senses.title: Someone who travels through time
senses.definition: a person imagined to move between different times
senses.definitionCN: 想象中在不同时间之间穿行的人
senses.example: The novel follows a time traveller.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说跟着一位时间旅行者。
senses.why: Time is treated as a country to be crossed, so the ordinary noun needs no new form.
senses.whyCN: 时间被当成一个国家来穿越，所以这个普通名词不必换形。

intro.en: The word is travel plus -er, and travel itself comes from Old French travail, labour or hardship.
intro.cn: 这个词是 travel 加 -er，而 travel 本身来自古法语 travail（劳作、艰辛）。

items.en: Travail means labour, toil, or trouble, from a late Latin word for a torture device.
items.cn: 古法语 travail 意为劳作、辛苦，源自晚期拉丁语指刑具的词。

items.en: Travel still means hard going in Middle English, and the traveller is one who endures it.
items.cn: 中世纪英语里 travel 仍指艰苦的路途，traveller 就是承受它的人。

items.en: As journeys grow easier, the word loses its sting and simply means making a trip.
items.cn: 随着旅途变得容易，这个词失去苦味，只表示出行。

items.en: The -er ending marks the person, and American spelling drops one l.
items.cn: -er 词尾标记那个人，美式拼写少一个 l。

items.en: The capitalised form names travelling communities in Britain and Ireland.
items.cn: 首字母大写的形式在英伦指流浪民族群体。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on travel itself, while the near-meaning group names other people on the move.
note.cn: 形近组由 travel 本身构出，近义组列出其他在路上的人。

normal.cn: travel 是动词，traveller 是干这件事的人。

normal.cn: 英式拼写在 -er、-ing 前双写 l。

abstract.en: Picture one bag, one ticket, one clock above a wide station.
abstract.cn: 想象一个包、一张票、车站大钟。

abstract.en: Notice the bag is old and the shoes are dusty.
abstract.cn: 留意包很旧，鞋上有灰。

abstract.en: Then let the same figure step into another century.
abstract.cn: 再让同一个人跨进另一个世纪。

examples.en: The station was full of tired travellers.
examples.cn: 车站里挤满了疲惫的旅客。

examples.en: As a seasoned traveller, he packs in ten minutes.
examples.cn: 作为走惯路的人，他十分钟就收拾好行李。

examples.en: The museum tells the story of a time traveller.
examples.cn: 博物馆讲了一个时间旅行者的故事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿沃勒」——穿过一片沃野，勒紧背包的旅行者。

root: 古法语 travail（劳作、辛苦）+ 后缀 -er；同族有 travel、traveler、trouble

sensesIntro.en: The senses spread from one person on one journey to a whole community and to a moving machine part.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从「一个人一趟行程」，扩展到一整个群体与一个会移动的零件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dusty backpacker waiting under a station clock.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个满身灰尘的背包客在车站大钟下等车。

branches.en: The single-journey sense, the plainest use.
branches.cn: 单趟义：最朴素的用法。

branches.en: The habitual sense, where travel is a way of life.
branches.cn: 习惯义：旅行成了生活方式。

branches.en: The community sense, capitalised, tied to Britain and Ireland.
branches.cn: 群体义：首字母大写，与英伦相关。

branches.en: The mechanical sense, a part that runs along a beam.
branches.cn: 机械义：沿横梁滑动的部件。

branches.en: The imagined sense, crossing times rather than places.
branches.cn: 想象义：跨越的是时间而地点。

intro.en: The suffix marks the person, and travel has a French ancestor with a rough history.
intro.cn: 后缀标记人，而 travel 有个来历坎坷的法语祖先。

latinIntro.en: The stem travel- appears in travel, traveller, travelogue, and the American traveler.
latinIntro.cn: 词干 travel- 出现在 travel、traveller、travelogue 与美式 traveler 里。

items.exampleCN: 英式拼写保留两个 l。

items.example: The American form drops one l.

items.meaning: a talk or book about travels

items.example: The trip was trouble from the start.
items.exampleCN: 这趟旅程从一开始就麻烦不断。

definition_zh: 托盘；盘子；浅盘；一盘（量）
definition_en: a flat container with a low rim, used to carry or hold food or small objects
core_image: 食堂里一只手稳稳托着一只方盘，盘上摆着三个碗
scene: 食堂窗口前，学生把餐盘往台上一推，盘里三样菜汤都没洒。He carried the tray carefully to the table.
sceneCN: 这里 tray 是「托盘」（第 1 个义项：带浅边的平盘，用来端东西）；句意为他小心地把托盘端到桌上。方盘上摆着碗的画面正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 复合词，义为「烟灰缸」
名词加 -ful 构成，义为「一托盘之量」
复数形式，也可作动词「放在托盘里」的第三人称

senses.title: A flat carrier with a rim
senses.definition: a flat shallow container with a raised edge for carrying things
senses.definitionCN: 边缘略高、用来端东西的浅平容器
senses.example: She put the cups on the tray.
senses.exampleCN: 她把杯子放在托盘上。
senses.why: The low rim keeps things from sliding off, which is all the word originally meant.
senses.whyCN: 浅浅的边防止东西滑落，这就是这个词最初的全部意思。

senses.title: A dish for serving food
senses.definition: a shallow dish used to serve or hold food
senses.definitionCN: 用来盛放或上菜的浅盘
senses.example: The waiter brought a tray of sandwiches.
senses.exampleCN: 侍者端来一盘三明治。
senses.why: When the flat dish goes to the table, the same shape is called a serving tray.
senses.whyCN: 当这只平盘被端上桌时，同一个形状就叫上菜盘。

senses.title: A shallow open container
senses.definition: a shallow open container used for holding small items in order
senses.definitionCN: 用来分格盛小物件的浅盒
senses.example: Put the seeds in a tray of soil.
senses.exampleCN: 把种子放进一盘土里。
senses.why: Any shallow open box that keeps things in place can borrow the shape of the tray.
senses.whyCN: 任何能把东西固定住的浅开口盒子，都可以借用托盘的这个形状。

senses.title: The amount one tray holds
senses.definition: as much as a tray will hold
senses.definitionCN: 一只托盘能容纳的量
senses.example: We baked a tray of biscuits.
senses.exampleCN: 我们烤了一盘饼干。
senses.why: A container often measures what it holds, so the tray becomes a unit of quantity.
senses.whyCN: 容器常被用来计量它所装的东西，于是托盘成了一种计量单位。

senses.title: A desk container for papers
senses.definition: a flat open container on a desk for letters or papers
senses.definitionCN: 桌上放信件文件的平盘
senses.example: The letter is in the in tray.
senses.exampleCN: 信在收件盘里。
senses.why: Papers are stacked in the same shallow shape, so the office borrows the kitchen word.
senses.whyCN: 文件也堆在同样的浅形里，于是办公室借用了厨房的词。

intro.en: The word comes through Old French from a Germanic source, and has named a flat dish for many centuries.
intro.cn: 这个词经古法语来自日耳曼语源，几个世纪以来都指一种平盘。

items.en: Old French trai or tray means a flat board or dish for carrying food.
items.cn: 古法语 trai、tray 指端食物用的平板或盘子。

items.en: The French word comes from a Germanic root related to Dutch drag, a tray or trough.
items.cn: 法语词来自日耳曼词根，与荷兰语 drag（托盘、槽）相关。

items.en: English takes the word for a flat serving dish in the Middle Ages.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪借入这个词，指平的盛菜盘。

items.en: Use widens to ice trays, seed trays, and desk trays for papers.
items.cn: 用法扩展到冰格、育苗盘与桌上的文件盘。

items.en: The word also measures amounts, as in a tray of cakes.
items.cn: 这个词也用来计量，如一盘蛋糕。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that look close, while the near-meaning group names other things that hold and carry.
note.cn: 形近组汇集外形接近的短词，近义组列出其他承载与盛放的器物。

normal.cn: 托盘有边，盘子没有。

examples.en: Fill the ice tray with water.

examples.en: A tray of glasses stood by the door.
examples.cn: 门边放着一托盘杯子。

sensesIntro.en: Every sense is the same flat shape with a small edge, carrying whatever it is given.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都是同一个带浅边的扁平形状，装它该装的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand steady under a square tray of bowls.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手稳稳托着摆了三只碗的方盘。

branches.en: The carrying sense, the plainest use of the word.
branches.cn: 承载义：这个词最朴素的用法。

branches.en: The serving sense, where the tray goes to the table.
branches.cn: 上菜义：托盘被端到桌边。

branches.en: The organising senses: seeds in a grid, papers in a desk tray.
branches.cn: 整理义：格里的种子，桌上的文件盘。

branches.en: The measure sense, a tray full of biscuits.
branches.cn: 计量义：满满一盘饼干。

branches.en: The default sense: one hand, one tray, three bowls.
branches.cn: 默认义：一只手、一只托盘、三只碗。

intro.cn: 一个借来的法语词，形式简单，构词却很能派用场。

items.example: The plate is for a single dish.

definition_zh: 对待；看待；治疗；招待；请客
definition_en: to behave towards someone in a certain way, to give medical care, or to pay for food for someone
core_image: 大人弯下腰，蹲到孩子眼睛的高度才开口说话
scene: 诊所里，医生对照片子一条条讲清病情，又叮嘱护士怎样照看。The doctor treated the burn with a cool dressing.
sceneCN: 这里 treat 是「治疗」（第 2 个义项：对病人施以医疗照顾）；句意为医生用冷敷处理了烫伤。先蹲下来与病人齐眼说话的画面，正是「对待」的本义。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ment 构成名词，义为「治疗；对待」
同根名词，义为「论著」
同根名词，义为「条约」

senses.title: To behave towards someone
senses.definition: to behave in a particular way towards a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式对待人或物
senses.example: She treats her students as equals.
senses.exampleCN: 她把学生当平等的人看待。
senses.why: The Latin tractare means to handle, and how you handle people is how you treat them.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tractare 意为「处理、摆弄」，你怎么摆弄人，就是怎么对待人。

senses.title: To give medical care
senses.definition: to give medical care to a sick or injured person
senses.definitionCN: 对病人或伤者施以医疗
senses.example: The doctor treated him for a broken wrist.
senses.exampleCN: 医生给他治腕骨骨折。
senses.why: Medicine is a special kind of handling, so the same verb takes on the clinic.
senses.whyCN: 医疗是处理的一种特别方式，于是同一个动词走进了诊室。

senses.title: To deal with a substance
senses.definition: to apply a process to a material so that it changes
senses.definitionCN: 对材料施加某种工序使其改变
senses.example: The wood is treated against rot.
senses.exampleCN: 这木材经过防腐处理。
senses.why: Handling a material with a chemical is literally a handling, and the verb fits.
senses.whyCN: 用化学品去处理材料，字面上就是「摆弄」，动词正合适。

senses.title: To give food or fun at your cost
senses.definition: to buy food or entertainment for someone as a gift
senses.definitionCN: 花钱请别人吃东西或娱乐
senses.example: He treated us to lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 他请我们吃了午饭。
senses.why: Handling someone generously in a social setting becomes paying for them.
senses.whyCN: 在社交场合大方地「对付」某人，就变成了替他们付钱。

senses.title: A gift or pleasure given
senses.definition: something enjoyable given as a gift, or a special pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 作为礼物给人的享受，或特别的乐事
senses.example: The trip was a real treat.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行真是难得的乐事。
senses.why: The noun keeps the sense of something generously handled and then given.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了「被大方地打理好然后送给人」的含义。

senses.title: To discuss or write about
senses.definition: to deal with a subject in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 以口头或书面方式讨论一个主题
senses.example: The book treats the subject briefly.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书对这个问题论述简略。
senses.why: Tractare also meant to discuss, the sense that survives in treatise and treaty.
senses.whyCN: tractare 也有「讨论」义，这层意思留在 treatise 与 treaty 里。

intro.en: The verb comes from Old French traitier, from Latin tractare, to handle or discuss.
intro.cn: 这个动词来自古法语 traitier，源头是拉丁语 tractare（处理、讨论）。

items.en: Trahere means to draw or pull, and tractare is its frequentative, to keep handling.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉，tractare 是它的反复形式，意为反复摆弄。

items.en: Traitier means to deal with a person, to negotiate, or to discuss a matter.
items.cn: 古法语 traitier 意为与人打交道、谈判或讨论某事。

items.en: English takes the verb for behaving towards people and for handling subjects.
items.cn: 英语借入这个动词，用于待人与论述主题。

items.en: Medicine turns handling into healing, and hospitality turns it into paying.
items.cn: 医学把「处理」变成治疗，好客把「处理」变成付钱。

items.en: The noun treat, a pleasure, appears much later than the verb.
items.cn: 名词 treat（乐事）比动词晚得多才出现。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tract- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of dealing with people or illness.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tract- 词干，近义组汇集表示待人、治病的其他动词。

normalIntro.en: Treat, treaty, treatise and treatment all grow from one Latin verb of handling.
normalIntro.cn: treat、treaty、treatise、treatment 都出自同一个表示「处理」的拉丁动词。

normal.en: Tractare is to handle, so treat is to handle a person, a wound, or a subject.
normal.cn: tractare 是处理，所以 treat 是处理一个人、一处伤或一个题目。

normal.en: Treatment is the noun: how someone or something is handled.
normal.cn: treatment 是名词：某人或某物被怎样处理。

normal.en: A treaty is a handling written down between states.
normal.cn: treaty 是国家之间写下来的「处理」。

normal.en: My treat means I pay, the handling made generous.
normal.cn: my treat 是我付钱，把「处理」变成了大方。

normal.en: The past is treated, and the door of the clinic uses the same word.
normal.cn: 过去式是 treated，诊所门上用的也是这个词。

abstract.en: Picture an adult bending to a child’s height before speaking.
abstract.cn: 想象大人弯到孩子的高度再开口。

abstract.en: The same bend is made over a wound, and over a hard material.
abstract.cn: 同一个弯腰，对着伤口，也对着硬材料。

abstract.en: Then see a hand reaching for the bill at dinner.
abstract.cn: 再看见饭后一只手去拿账单。

examples.en: They treated the old man with great respect.
examples.cn: 他们非常敬重这位老人。

examples.en: The nurse treated the cut and sent him home.
examples.cn: 护士处理了伤口就送他回家了。

examples.en: Let me treat you to a coffee.
examples.cn: 让我请你喝杯咖啡。

sensesIntro.en: All senses are ways of handling something: a person, a wound, a material, a subject, or a bill.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都是「处理」：处理一个人、一处伤、一种材料、一个题目，或一笔账。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an adult bending down to a child’s eye level.
core.cn: 核心意象：大人蹲到与孩子齐眼的高度。

branches.en: The social sense, how one person handles another.
branches.cn: 人际义：一个人怎样对待另一个人。

branches.en: The technical senses: handling a body or a material.
branches.cn: 技术义：处理身体或处理材料。

branches.en: The generous senses: paying, and the pleasure paid for.
branches.cn: 慷慨义：付钱，以及花钱买来的乐事。

branches.en: The written sense, kept alive in treatise and treaty.
branches.cn: 书面义：活在 treatise 与 treaty 里。

branches.en: The material sense, where timber is the thing handled.
branches.cn: 材料义：被处理的是木料。

intro.cn: 这个动词是磨圆了的拉丁语「处理」动词，词族很大。

latinIntro.en: The tract- stem appears in treat, treaty, treatment, tract, contract, and extract.
latinIntro.cn: tract- 词干出现在 treat、treaty、treatment、tract、contract 与 extract 里。

items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 tract 与 contract。

definition_zh: 治疗；疗法；对待；处理；处理方式
definition_en: the care given to cure an illness or injury, or the way a person or thing is dealt with
core_image: 病床边挂着输液袋，护士按表一格一格记录换药
scene: 住院部的床头挂着卡片，护士按上面的疗程逐日换药记录。The new treatment reduced the pain within a week.
sceneCN: 这里 treatment 是「治疗、疗法」（第 1 个义项：为治愈而给的医疗照护）；句意为新疗法一周内就减轻了疼痛。床头那张逐日记录的卡片正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 -ment 还原为动词，义为「对待；治疗」
由 treat 加 -able 构成，义为「可治疗的」

senses.title: Medical care for an illness
senses.definition: the care and medicine given to cure a disease or injury
senses.definitionCN: 为治愈疾病或伤处而给的照护与药物
senses.example: She is receiving treatment for the infection.
senses.exampleCN: 她正在接受感染治疗。
senses.why: Treating a patient is handling the body back to health, and the noun names that handling.
senses.whyCN: 治疗病人就是把身体料理回健康，名词指的就是这份料理。

senses.title: A particular method of healing
senses.definition: a specific way of treating a disease
senses.definitionCN: 治疗某种病的具体办法
senses.example: The clinic offers two treatments for the knee.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所对膝关节有两种疗法。
senses.why: Once methods are compared, the noun shifts from care in general to one named method.
senses.whyCN: 一旦比较各种方法，名词就从笼统的照护转向某一种有名字的疗法。

senses.title: The way a person is dealt with
senses.definition: the way someone is behaved towards
senses.definitionCN: 别人对待某人的方式
senses.example: The workers asked for fair treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们要求公平对待。
senses.why: The oldest sense of treat is to behave towards, so treatment is simply how that behaves out.
senses.whyCN: treat 最老的含义就是「朝向某人的行为」，treatment 就是把这种行为表现出的样子。

senses.title: A process applied to a material
senses.definition: a process that is applied to a substance to change it
senses.definitionCN: 为使物质改变而施加的工序
senses.example: The water needs chemical treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 这水需要化学处理。
senses.why: Handling a material is the same handling as handling a person, only without feeling.
senses.whyCN: 处理材料与待人同属「处理」，只是对象没有感情。

senses.title: A way of presenting a subject
senses.definition: the way a writer or artist deals with a subject
senses.definitionCN: 作者或艺术家处理题材的方式
senses.example: Her treatment of the war is very restrained.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这场战争的处理很克制。
senses.why: Tractare also meant to discuss, so how a subject is discussed is its treatment.
senses.whyCN: tractare 也有讨论义，所以一个题目被怎样讨论，就是它的「处理方式」。

intro.en: The noun is treat plus -ment, and treat comes from Latin tractare, to handle.
intro.cn: 这个名词是 treat 加 -ment，而 treat 出自拉丁语 tractare（处理）。

items.en: Tractare is the frequentative of trahere, to draw, and means to keep handling.
items.cn: tractare 是 trahere（拉）的反复形式，意为反复摆弄。

items.en: Traitier gives the English verb treat, for dealing with people and matters.
items.cn: 古法语 traitier 生出英语动词 treat，用于待人与处事。

items.en: The -ment ending turns the verb into a noun of the handling itself.
items.cn: -ment 词尾把动词变成表示「处理本身」的名词。

items.en: Medicine makes the medical sense the dominant one in modern use.
items.cn: 现代用法中，医学义成了最主要的义项。

items.en: Industry and journalism extend it to water, waste, and the handling of subjects.
items.cn: 工业与新闻业把它扩展到水、废物与题材的处理上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the treat- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for care and handling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 treat- 词干，近义组汇集表示照护与处理的其他说法。

normal.en: Treatment in a hospital is handling a body back to health.

normal.en: Mistreatment adds mis-, meaning handling the wrong way.

normal.en: Water treatment plants handle water, not patients.

normal.en: The word appears in headlines about fair and unfair handling alike.

definition_zh: 发抖；震颤；摇晃；担忧
definition_en: to shake slightly and quickly, from cold, fear, or weakness, or to shake as a thing does
core_image: 一双端着碗的手，碗里的水泛起细密的圈
scene: 雪地里，等候的人把手插进袖口，还是止不住地抖。She was trembling with cold at the bus stop.
sceneCN: 这里 tremble 是「发抖」（第 1 个义项：因寒冷、恐惧或虚弱而轻快地颤）；句意为她在公交站冻得直发抖。袖口里止不住颤的手正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 现在分词名词化，义为「颤抖」；也可作形容词「发抖的」
同根形容词，义为「颤抖的；胆怯的」
同根名词，义为「轻微震动；颤栗」

senses.title: To shake from cold or fear
senses.definition: to shake quickly and slightly because of cold, fear, or weakness
senses.definitionCN: 因寒冷、恐惧或体弱而轻快地抖动
senses.example: His hands trembled as he opened the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 他拆信时手在发抖。
senses.why: The Latin verb tremere means to shake, and the English word keeps its plainest sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 tremere 意为抖动，英语这个词保留的正是最朴素的那层意思。

senses.title: To shake with strong feeling
senses.definition: to shake because of anger, excitement, or another strong feeling
senses.definitionCN: 因愤怒、激动等强烈情绪而抖
senses.example: She trembled with rage at the words.
senses.exampleCN: 听到那些话她气得发抖。
senses.why: If cold can shake a body, so can feeling, and the verb needs no new shape for it.
senses.whyCN: 寒冷能让身体抖，情绪也能，动词不必换形就能用。

senses.title: To shake, as a thing does
senses.definition: to shake slightly, said of leaves, water, or the ground
senses.definitionCN: 轻微抖动，用于树叶、水面或地面
senses.example: The leaves trembled in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 树叶在风里轻轻颤动。
senses.why: Latin used tremere of the earth as well as of limbs, so the word still covers things without a will.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语用 tremere 既指四肢也指大地，所以这个词照样管没有意志的东西。

senses.title: To be afraid of what may come
senses.definition: to feel fear or worry about something that may happen
senses.definitionCN: 对可能发生的事感到害怕或不安
senses.example: He trembled at the thought of the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 一想到考试他就心慌。
senses.why: Fear is felt in the body first, so the outward shaking comes to name the inner fear.
senses.whyCN: 恐惧先在身体上显现，于是外在的抖动就被用来指内心的害怕。

senses.title: A shaking of the body or voice
senses.definition: a slight shaking, especially of the body or the voice
senses.definitionCN: 轻度的抖动，尤指身体或嗓音
senses.example: There was a tremble in her voice.
senses.exampleCN: 她的嗓音里有一丝颤抖。
senses.why: The noun is simply the verb turned into a thing, naming the shaking itself.
senses.whyCN: 名词就是把这个动词变成一样东西，给抖动本身起名。

intro.en: The verb comes through French from Latin tremere, to shake, which also gave tremor and tremulous.
intro.cn: 这个动词经法语来自拉丁语 tremere（抖动），tremor 与 tremulous 同出此源。

items.en: Tremere means to shake or quake, and is used of the earth and of limbs alike.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tremere 意为抖动、震动，大地与四肢都用它。

items.en: Tremulus means trembling, and gives English tremulous.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tremulus 意为发抖的，生出英语 tremulous。

items.en: Old French trembler keeps the plain sense of shaking with cold or fear.
items.cn: 古法语 trembler 保留因寒冷或恐惧而抖的朴素义。

items.en: English borrows the verb early and uses it for both bodies and leaves.
items.cn: 英语很早就借入这个动词，既用于人，也用于树叶。

items.en: The noun form appears later, usually of the voice or the hands.
items.cn: 名词形式出现较晚，多指嗓音或手。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the trem- root of shaking, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of unsteady motion.
note.cn: 形近组共用表示抖动的 trem- 词根，近义组汇集其他表示不稳震动的动词。
